ddl.value: ("action" = 'MANUAL_CREATED' AND "before_state" IS NULL) OR ("action" = 'ATTENDANCE_CORRECTED' AND "before_state" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: attendance_audit_logs_action_state

ddl.value: "source" <> 'MANUAL' OR ("manual_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("manual_reason")) > 0)
ddl.name: attendance_records_manual_reason

ddl.value: ("source" = 'QR' AND "scan_lat" IS NOT NULL AND "scan_lng" IS NOT NULL AND "gps_accuracy_m" IS NOT NULL AND "scan_lat" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "scan_lng" BETWEEN -180 AND 180 AND "gps_accuracy_m" > 0 AND "gps_accuracy_m" < 'Infinity'::double precision) OR ("source" = 'MANUAL' AND "scan_lat" IS NULL AND "scan_lng" IS NULL AND "gps_accuracy_m" IS NULL)
ddl.name: attendance_records_gps_package

ddl.value: ("status" = 'INACTIVE' AND "activated_at" IS NULL AND "closed_at" IS NULL) OR ("status" = 'ACTIVE' AND "activated_at" IS NOT NULL AND "closed_at" IS NULL) OR ("status" = 'CLOSED' AND "closed_at" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: attendance_sessions_lifecycle

ddl.value: ("status" = 'DRAFT' AND "published_at" IS NULL AND "closed_at" IS NULL) OR ("status" = 'PUBLISHED' AND "published_at" IS NOT NULL AND "closed_at" IS NULL) OR ("status" = 'CLOSED' AND "published_at" IS NOT NULL AND "closed_at" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: events_lifecycle

ddl.value: ("action" IN ('ACCOUNT_CREATED', 'ACCOUNT_UPDATED', 'ACCOUNT_ARCHIVED', 'PASSWORD_RESET', 'PERIOD_CREATED', 'PERIOD_EXTENDED', 'PERIOD_ASSIGNED') AND "actor_user_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("action" = 'SYSTEM_ADMIN_BOOTSTRAPPED' AND "actor_user_id" IS NULL)
ddl.name: account_audit_logs_action_check
